_comment: Guided tour for the IRF & BG calibration step. Targets: spec attrs (display_detector, sel_conv_start, sel_irf_start, sel_bg_vv), the spec's custom section keys (path_list, decay_conv) and the app's own buttons by name (open_source, apply). Read by chisurf.emtk.help_guide.

steps.title: Calibrate once, per detector
steps.text: Phasor and the pixel-wise MLE need, for each detector, the instrument response and the background. Set them here once; Apply hands them on. Skipping the step uses the raw data.

steps.title: The source decay
steps.text: The photon file whose decay you calibrate against — in the imaging pipeline it comes from the earlier steps.

await.hint: Press Open TTTR… and pick the measurement.

steps.title: Which detector
steps.text: Every setting below belongs to the detector chosen here; switching detector shows its own.

steps.title: Its IRF
steps.text: A scatter or reflection measurement for this detector. Several files are summed. No file: the raw data are used.

steps.title: The windows
steps.text: Conv is the fit window (blue), IRF the part of the IRF that is used (green). Type them here or drag the lines on the plot.

steps.title: The background
steps.text: Drag the grey region over a stretch before the pulse: its mean counts become the VV and VH backgrounds. Or type them; 0 means an automatic baseline.

steps.title: Check on the decay
steps.text: The IRF should sit on the rising edge of the decay; the shift fields move it, wrapping around, by whole or fractional channels.

steps.title: Hand it on
steps.text: Apply refuses an empty window or a negative background, and otherwise passes every detector's calibration to Phasor and the MLE.
